description: Designer specification for a new F&O model, not SQL DDL or an importable metadata/model package.

UBHRExternalId.meaning: Requirement, candidate, application, or evaluation external ID

UBHRIdentityIssuer.meaning: Validated OIDC issuer; never a browser-supplied identity

UBHRIdentitySubject.meaning: Validated OIDC subject; never an email or public profile URL

UBHRHash.meaning: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256; also used for IdentityKey

UBHRUrl.meaning: Optional candidate-supplied HTTPS LinkedIn profile URL

UBHRResumeFileName.meaning: Sanitized display filename; matches the backend limit

UBHRBlobReference.meaning: Private storage reference including the unchanged azure: prefix

UBHRCode.meaning: Work mode, employment type, or evidence match label

UBHRConsentVersion.meaning: Accepted privacy and processing notice version

UBHRExperienceYears.meaning: Actual minimum or maximum relevant experience in years

UBHRMatchScore.meaning: Evidence alignment score, validated between 0 and 100

standard_edts.Notes: Standard unbounded long-text EDT; use it for JD, prose and JSON memo fields.
standard_edts.RefRecId: Standard Int64 EDT; explicit table relations below supply each foreign key.

UBHRJobRequirement.purpose: Complete published requirement and JD context; adapt the service mapping if an existing requirement table is authoritative.

fields.name: RequirementId
fields.meaning: Stable external requirement ID, shared consistently with application.RequirementId

fields.name: JobTitle
fields.meaning: Advertised job title

fields.name: JobDescription
fields.meaning: Complete JD, with no truncation to a card-length summary

fields.name: Responsibilities
fields.meaning: Complete responsibilities

fields.name: RequiredSkills
fields.meaning: Comma/newline-delimited required skills; the adapter normalizes them to a list

fields.name: PreferredSkills
fields.meaning: Comma/newline-delimited preferred skills

fields.name: MinimumExperienceYears
fields.meaning: Actual advertised minimum; zero means an actual zero-year threshold in this baseline

fields.name: MaximumExperienceYears
fields.meaning: Actual advertised maximum; publish accurate values

fields.name: RequiredQualifications
fields.meaning: Complete required qualifications

fields.name: RequiredCertifications
fields.meaning: Comma/newline-delimited required certifications

fields.name: Department
fields.meaning: Advertised department

fields.name: JobLocation
fields.meaning: Advertised location

fields.name: WorkMode
fields.meaning: Remote, Hybrid, or Onsite, as an actual string value

fields.name: EmploymentType
fields.meaning: FullTime, PartTime, Contract, or Internship

fields.name: NumberOfOpenings
fields.meaning: Actual number of openings; publication requires a positive value

fields.name: JobStatus
fields.meaning: Draft / Open / Closed; default Draft

fields.name: PublishedDateTime
fields.meaning: Actual UTC publication time

fields.name: ClosingDateTime
fields.meaning: Actual UTC closing time; an empty value represents no configured deadline

fields.name: HiringManagerWorkerRecId
fields.meaning: Optional worker RecId; requires HcmWorker relation if used

fields.name: RubricVersion
fields.meaning: Actual criteria version; empty when not provided

fields.name: EvaluationCriteriaJson
fields.meaning: Optional valid JSON object of job-specific evaluation criteria

UBHRCandidate.purpose: One current contact/profile master per authenticated LinkedIn identity in the configured company.

fields.name: CandidateId
fields.meaning: Stable CAN- plus 36-character GUID; exactly 40 characters

fields.name: IdentityKey
fields.meaning: SHA-256 of the service helper's unambiguous issuer/subject encoding; unique per company

fields.name: LinkedInIssuer
fields.meaning: Validated immutable OIDC issuer

fields.name: LinkedInSub
fields.meaning: Validated immutable OIDC subject

fields.name: FullName
fields.meaning: Current candidate-confirmed contact name

fields.name: Email
fields.meaning: Current candidate-confirmed contact email

fields.name: Phone
fields.meaning: Optional current phone

fields.name: LinkedInUrl
fields.meaning: Optional supplied public profile URL; never derive it from a member URN

fields.name: LinkedInProfileJson
fields.meaning: Allowlisted provider profile, separate from edited contact data; no OAuth credentials

fields.name: ConsentVersion
fields.meaning: Latest accepted notice version

fields.name: ConsentDateTime
fields.meaning: Latest accepted consent timestamp

UBHRJobApplication.purpose: Immutable per-submission owner, contact, profile, document and consent snapshot, linked to candidate and requirement.

fields.name: ApplicationId
fields.meaning: Stable APP- plus 36-character GUID; exactly 40 characters

fields.name: CandidateRecId
fields.meaning: FK to UBHRCandidate.RecId in the same company

fields.name: RequirementRecId
fields.meaning: FK to UBHRJobRequirement.RecId in the same company

fields.name: RequirementId
fields.meaning: External requirement ID snapshot, consistent with the related requirement

fields.name: LinkedInIssuer
fields.meaning: Immutable validated owner issuer snapshot

fields.name: LinkedInSub
fields.meaning: Immutable validated owner subject snapshot

fields.name: LinkedInProfileJson
fields.meaning: Provider profile captured for this application

fields.name: FullName
fields.meaning: Name confirmed for this application

fields.name: Email
fields.meaning: Contact email confirmed for this application

fields.name: Phone
fields.meaning: Optional contact phone snapshot

fields.name: LinkedInUrl
fields.meaning: Optional confirmed public profile URL

fields.name: ResumeFileName
fields.meaning: Validated PDF/DOCX display filename, maximum 150 characters

fields.name: ResumeBlobKey
fields.meaning: Backend-owned private reference, unchanged; never a public URL or Base64 document

fields.name: ResumeSha256
fields.meaning: SHA-256 of the uploaded document bytes

fields.name: JDHash
fields.meaning: SHA-256 of the complete JD context supplied with the accepted submission

fields.name: ResumeExtractJson
fields.meaning: Reserved optional extraction metadata; current service does not populate it

fields.name: AppliedDateTime
fields.meaning: Server-assigned UTC application submission time

fields.name: AIStatus
fields.meaning: Pending initially; Completed only when evaluation transaction commits

fields.name: HRStatus
fields.meaning: Submitted initially; separate human-review workflow

fields.name: ConsentVersion
fields.meaning: Accepted notice version captured for this application

fields.name: ConsentDateTime
fields.meaning: Accepted consent timestamp captured for this application

fields.name: IdempotencyKey
fields.meaning: Unique persistent submit request reference

fields.name: PayloadHash
fields.meaning: Request-content SHA-256; a retry with changed contents must be rejected

UBHRMatchEvaluation.purpose: One current resume-versus-JD evaluation per application, separate from candidate and application contact information.

fields.name: EvaluationId
fields.meaning: Stable EVA- plus 36-character GUID; exactly 40 characters

fields.name: ApplicationRecId
fields.meaning: FK to UBHRJobApplication.RecId; unique current evaluation

fields.name: RequirementRecId
fields.meaning: FK to the application's own requirement in the same company

fields.name: Score
fields.meaning: Actual validated model score, 0–100; no automatic hire or rejection decision

fields.name: MeetsMinimumCriteria
fields.meaning: Evidence-based model assessment; DTO serializes this as a JSON boolean

fields.name: MatchLabel
fields.meaning: Model evidence label, for example StrongEvidence, PartialEvidence, InsufficientEvidence

fields.name: ScoreJustification
fields.meaning: Detailed explanation of the supplied score

fields.name: Summary
fields.meaning: Overall evidence summary

fields.name: MatchedSkillsJson
fields.meaning: Serialized matched evidence array

fields.name: PartiallyMatchedJson
fields.meaning: Serialized partial evidence array

fields.name: MissingSkillsJson
fields.meaning: Serialized not-evidenced requirement array

fields.name: EvidenceJson
fields.meaning: Serialized relevant evidence array

fields.name: EvaluationConfidence
fields.meaning: Actual High / Medium / Low confidence label

fields.name: ModelDeployment
fields.meaning: Actual deployment used for this evaluation

fields.name: PromptVersion
fields.meaning: Actual version-controlled scoring prompt

fields.name: RubricVersion
fields.meaning: Actual job rubric version when available

fields.name: EvaluatedDateTime
fields.meaning: UTC completion time of the saved evaluation

fields.name: IdempotencyKey
fields.meaning: Evaluation worker request reference

fields.name: PayloadHash
fields.meaning: Current evaluation content digest; identical retries reuse it and changed content replaces the current evaluation

conventions: SaveDataPerCompany=Yes: F&O adds company scoping to database keys. Do not create a duplicate DataAreaId field or manually add it to every index.
Never put LinkedInIssuer + LinkedInSub into a wide composite string index. The unique IdentityKey digest avoids the SQL index-key length issue; service also compares the full stored identity.
The same UBHRExternalId EDT is used for all external IDs, including requirement snapshots; there is no 40/50 discrepancy.
Notes preserves full JD and JSON. Do not replace it with String(1000), String(4000), or a fictitious Memo primitive field type.
Content defaults and response defaults are service/DTO rules, not SQL Default properties on AOT fields. Absent optional profile snapshots persist blank and serialize as {}.
The service returns explicit English status names; UI and adapter do not depend on translated enum labels or numeric enum values.
No Base64 documents, access tokens, ID tokens, refresh tokens, or OAuth session state belong in these tables.
Existing requirement-table adaptation is a separate mapping task; this baseline never overwrites a pre-existing table.
